namespace scpp\compiler;
require '/home/alexv/__AI/simple_cpp/simple_cpp_01/compiler/my-try/boot.php';
$stage = 'parse';
try {
    $compiler = new Compiler();
    $compiler->init([$argv[1]]);
    $compiler->sync([]);
    $stage = 'prepare';
    $compiler->prepare();
    $stage = 'emit';
    $compiler->cpp();
    file_put_contents($argv[1] . '/main.cpp', Model::$cpp_files[0]->text);
    echo json_encode(['phase' => 'emitted']);
} catch (\Throwable $error) {
    echo json_encode(['phase' => $stage, 'error' => $error->getMessage()]);
}
